flowchart.title: CarparkCV Vehicle Detection Pipeline
flowchart.description: Overarching flowchart for the vehicle detection and classification system. This pipeline integrates Computer Vision (YOLO) with RAK Depth Sensor data to determine the best classification for vehicles.

node.label: RAK Data File
node.description: Raw distance/time data from RAK sensor.

node.label: Vehicle Tracker
node.description: Uses YOLO (v12/v8) to detect and track objects (cars, people, bicycles). Generates frame-by-frame counts and timestamps.

node.label: Detection Results
node.description: CSV containing timestamps and object counts per frame.

node.label: Data Synchronization
node.description: Aligns RAK sensor timestamps with Video timestamps. Merges depth data into the detection CSV.

node.label: Synced Detection & Depth
node.description: Combined data: CV detections + RAK depth readings.

node.label: Dip Analyzer
node.description: Analyzes depth "dips" (objects passing sensor). Calculates features: Duration, Max Depth, Variance, Fill Factor.

node.label: Dip Analysis Results
node.description: Feature vectors for each detected event/dip.

node.label: ML Classifier
node.description: Applies Random Forest/Decision Tree models. Classifies events as "Vehicle" or "Non-Vehicle" based on extracted features.

node.label: Final Classification Results
node.description: Final output containing original data plus ML predictions (is_vehicle probability).
